title: sherpa-onnx TTS model registry entry
description: Canonical schema for a single model in models.json. Auto-generated fields are populated by generate.py; curated fields come from overrides.py. All fields beyond the 'core' set are optional so existing consumers (rust-tts-wrapper, tts-wrapper) keep working without changes.

id.description: Stable unique identifier. Convention: '<developer>-<lang(s)>-<name>[-<quality>]'. Used as the key in models.json and as modelId in consumers.

model_type.description: sherpa-onnx OfflineTtsModelConfig branch. Determines which config builder a consumer uses.

developer.description: Upstream project / publisher (piper, coqui, icefall, mms, kokoro, supertone, mimic3, melo, kitten, vits).

name.description: Model variant name as parsed from the release filename (e.g. 'amy', 'v0_19', 'supertonic-3-int8').

description.description: One-line human-readable summary, auto-derived from developer + language + voice count + quality.

language.description: Languages this model can synthesise. Multilingual models (supertonic, kokoro-multi-lang) list every supported code.

sample_rate.description: Output audio sample rate in Hz.

num_speakers.description: Number of preset voices addressable by speaker id.

voice_names.description: Optional mapping of speaker id (as string) to a human-readable voice name. Only present for models with named presets (e.g. Supertonic M1–M5, F1–F5).

url.description: Download URL for the archive (or HF resolve directory for MMS).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the archive, from the GitHub release asset digest. Absent for sources that don't provide one (MMS).

compression.description: Whether the URL is a compressed archive (.tar.bz2/.tar.gz/.zip).

license.description: Best-effort license identifier (SPDX-style where possible: MIT, Apache-2.0, CC-BY-NC-4.0, OpenRAIL-M, …). 'unknown' means verify manually — never assume.

license_url.description: Link to the authoritative license text.

source_url.description: Model card / upstream page for attribution and deeper docs.

min_sherpa_onnx_version.description: First sherpa-onnx release supporting this model_type (semver-ish string). Consumers can skip models their pinned runtime can't load.

deprecated.description: True when the upstream project is archived or the model is no longer recommended.

deprecation_note.description: Why the model is deprecated, and any migration path.

tags.description: Search facets: model_type, on-device, multilingual, multi-speaker, int8, …

url_valid.description: Set by --validate. Absent until the URL has been HEAD-checked.
